Project Team and Roles: The project consortium included together world-class researchers and practitioners from Colorado State University (CSU), the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL), and Qualitas Health (QH) with expertise in polymers, enzyme engineering, algal strain engineering, photophysiology, systems biology, algal cultivation from laboratory to production scales, LCA, and TEA.
